rules-export.rulesToml:
# The rules in force on Alex’s MacBook Pro

[[policies]]
name = "push-main"
effect = "ask"
actions = ["git.push"]
branches = ["main", "release/*"]

rulePacks.name: Open
rulePacks.description: Refuses only what cannot be undone, and records everything else.
